param: collection_name (exists verdict across the CRUD lifecycle)

oracle.statement: never-created -> 200 + result.exists=false; live -> 200 + result.exists=true (invariant under point CRUD); post-delete -> 200 + result.exists=false; recreated -> 200 + result.exists=true; non-200/wrong verdict/shape violation = Type4, 5xx = Type3 after /healthz
